service: Use Case B — Deadline-Aware VEC Dynamic Service

distinct_stages_contract.note: forwarded, compute_completed, returned, deadline_success are distinct counters with distinct denominators. Conflating any pair is a semantic error.

forwarded.definition: Count of admitted tasks where execution RSU != ingress RSU and forwarding occurred

compute_completed.definition: Count of tasks that finished service work at execution RSU (regardless of return or deadline)

returned.definition: Count of tasks whose computed result was delivered toward vehicle (distinct from service completion)

deadline_success.definition: Count of tasks where end-to-end latency (queuing + service + forwarding + return) <= deadline

vehicle_actor.note: Exact V2I/V2V target is environment-selected (strongest-link by default). Actor lacks RSU load awareness.

infrastructure_dispatcher.chooses: execution RSU (placement) via strongest-link / JSQ / P2C / DLA / DLA-P2C
infrastructure_dispatcher.admission_note: DLA includes admission feasibility rule — not a pure placement effect

prohibited_claims: Do not credit MAPPO actor with exact RSU choice
Do not equate waiting-room capacity with compute power
Do not call simulated scaling a Kubernetes deployment
Do not equate forwarded / compute_completed / returned / deadline_success

vocabulary_distinctions.vehicle_mode: actor mode choice, not RSU choice
vocabulary_distinctions.ingress_rsu: first RSU receiving task via radio link
vocabulary_distinctions.execution_rsu: RSU where task queues and is served; may differ from ingress RSU after forwarding
vocabulary_distinctions.admission: waiting-room ceiling check; rejected tasks never queue
vocabulary_distinctions.placement: selection of execution RSU for admitted tasks
vocabulary_distinctions.scaling: per-RSU compute-rate adjustment; Kubernetes-style simulation, not deployment

demo_scenario.description: Deadline-aware comparison of vehicle-side offloading vs infrastructure load management under common information
demo_scenario.trace: Manchester incident trace 15 March 2024 20:00-21:00 as primary; weekend ordinary as control
demo_scenario.admission_ceiling: rsu-cap-per-veh or rsu-cap-abs; document conversion when comparing traces
demo_scenario.note: Every run binds code commit, trace checksum, actor checksum, vec_env commit, SUMO version, seeds, and output checksums

arms.label: Existing vehicle-side offloading (frozen actor + strongest-link, LB off, fixed 1x)
arms.authority: vehicle actor chooses mode only; environment selects RSU

arms.label: DRL offloading + deterministic load balancing (A) — JSQ/P2C/DLA forwarding to quieter RSUs
arms.classification: requested investigation + proposed direction (S-035); not mandatory without additional confirmation

arms.label: DRL offloading + DRL-based scheduling (B) — learned execution-RSU policy (gated after deterministic baselines)
arms.classification: requested investigation + proposed direction; PROVISIONAL until controller spec approved

arms.label: DRL offloading + AI-based infrastructure/resource control (C) — reactive/proactive scaling
arms.classification: requested investigation + proposed direction; provisional wording; simulated until real deployment exists

comparison_output.conditional_metric: completion_admitted = deadline_success / admitted (diagnostic only; not headline)
required_metrics: offered, admitted, rejected, rejection reasons (offered = admitted + rejected)
compute_completed, returned, deadline_success as distinct counters
completion_offered and completion_admitted with explicit denominators
latency mean / p50 / p95 / p99 and deadline-met latency (admitted only; rejected tasks have no latency)
per-RSU load imbalance and time series
energy per offered and per admitted task
work conservation proof under physical semantics
resource denominator: mean multiplier, core-seconds, scale events, time-at-multiplier, first scale-up time
comparison_output.condition_map: Report conditional strengths/weaknesses per operating condition (incident vs ordinary) rather than universal winner
provenance_per_run: cap + LB mode + backhaul + scaling mode

s035_binding.problem: Task concentration at congested-road RSUs; farther RSUs idle; frozen policy lacks RSU capacity awareness; stale-broadcast concern
s035_binding.fail_fast_note: 2.5 -> 0.75 queue tightening reduced latency via quick rejection (fail-fast / accounting effect), not genuine improvement; motivates E1 semantic sweep
s035_binding.investigations_are: requested investigations / proposed directions / hypothesised outcomes as body supports; not mandatory deliverables without additional authoritative evidence
s035_binding.tt_req_008_priority: SHOULD unchanged; campaign status PARTIALLY_MET with raised direct source confidence
